what is python.en: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language used for general-purpose programming.
what is python.te: Python anedi high-level programming language, easy ga nerchukovachu.

features of python.en: Python is simple, readable, open-source and platform independent.
features of python.te: Python simple, readable, open-source mariyu platform independent.

applications of python.en: Python is used in web development, data science, AI, machine learning, automation and scripting.
applications of python.te: Python web development, data science, AI, machine learning, automation lo use chestaru.

variables in python.en: Variables are used to store data values in memory.
variables in python.te: Variables ante data values ni memory lo store cheyyadam.

rules for variables in python.en: Variable names must start with a letter or underscore and cannot start with a number.
rules for variables in python.te: Variable peru letter or underscore tho start avvali, number tho kaadu.

data types in python.en: Python supports int, float, complex, string, list, tuple, set and dictionary.
data types in python.te: Python lo int, float, complex, string, list, tuple, set, dictionary untayi.

type casting in python.en: Type casting converts one data type into another using int(), float(), str().
type casting in python.te: Type casting ante oka data type ni inkoka data type lo marchadam.

input output in python.en: Input is taken using input() and output is displayed using print().
input output in python.te: Input input() dwara tiskuntam, output print() dwara chupistam.

operators in python.en: Python supports arithmetic, relational, logical, assignment and membership operators.
operators in python.te: Python lo arithmetic, relational, logical, assignment operators untayi.

if else in python.en: if-else statements are used for decision making based on conditions.
if else in python.te: if-else conditions base chesi decision tiskovadaniki use chestaru.

loops in python.en: Loops are used to execute a block of code repeatedly.
loops in python.te: Loops code ni repeat cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

for loop in python.en: for loop is used to iterate over a sequence like list, tuple or string.
for loop in python.te: for loop list, tuple, string meeda iterate cheyyadaniki.

while loop in python.en: while loop executes as long as the condition is true.
while loop in python.te: while loop condition true unna varaku run avutundi.

break continue pass.en: break exits the loop, continue skips current iteration and pass does nothing.
break continue pass.te: break loop nundi bayataki vastundi, continue skip chestundi, pass emi cheyyadu.

functions in python.en: Functions are reusable blocks of code defined using def keyword.
functions in python.te: Functions reusable code blocks, def keyword tho define chestaru.

types of functions in python.en: Python supports built-in functions, user-defined functions and lambda functions.
types of functions in python.te: Python lo built-in, user-defined, lambda functions untayi.

lambda function in python.en: Lambda is an anonymous one-line function.

recursion in python.en: Recursion is a function calling itself to solve a problem.
recursion in python.te: Recursion ante function thane thanu call cheskovadam.

oops in python.en: OOPS includes class, object, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation and abstraction.
oops in python.te: OOPS lo class, object, inheritance, polymorphism, encapsulation, abstraction untayi.

class and object.en: A class is a blueprint and an object is an instance of a class.
class and object.te: Class blueprint, object class yokka instance.

constructor in python.en: Constructor is a special method __init__() used to initialize objects.

inheritance in python.en: Inheritance allows a class to acquire properties of another class.
inheritance in python.te: Inheritance ante oka class inkoka class properties tiskovadam.

polymorphism in python.en: Polymorphism allows methods to have same name with different behavior.
polymorphism in python.te: Polymorphism ante same method name, different behavior.

encapsulation in python.en: Encapsulation restricts access to variables and methods.
encapsulation in python.te: Encapsulation data ni protect cheyyadaniki access restrict chestundi.

abstraction in python.en: Abstraction hides implementation details and shows only functionality.
abstraction in python.te: Abstraction internal details hide chesi functionality matrame chupistundi.

exception handling in python.en: Exception handling manages runtime errors using try, except, else and finally.
exception handling in python.te: Exception handling runtime errors ni handle cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

file handling in python.en: File handling is used to read and write files using open().
file handling in python.te: File handling files read/write cheyyadaniki use chestaru.

modules in python.en: Modules are Python files that contain reusable code.
modules in python.te: Modules ante reusable code unna Python files.

packages in python.en: Packages are collections of modules organized in folders.
packages in python.te: Packages ante modules ni folders lo organize cheyyadam.

memory management in python.en: Python manages memory automatically using garbage collection.
memory management in python.te: Python garbage collection dwara memory ni automatic ga manage chestundi.

python advantages.en: Python is easy to learn, versatile and widely used.
python advantages.te: Python easy to learn, versatile mariyu widely used.

python disadvantages.en: Python is slower compared to compiled languages.

python vs java.en: Python is dynamically typed while Java is statically typed.
python vs java.te: Python dynamic typing, Java static typing.
